author: Woifi
body:
IGN: Wolfic
Discord( Name#): Wolfi#3347
Timezone: EST
Any previous Ref experience?: No, but I'm willing to spend some time and learn all about the job. 
Why would you like to join the referee team: I would enjoy joining the referee team because I feel like I would be a good fit for the task.  I can offer such things as helping out in tournaments, making them run smoother. Since I also have a lot of time to spare, I can ref a lot of games when needed. 
Are you able to commit to Saturday Tournaments, and occasionally event staff meetings? Yes, on Saturday I have a lot of time to come and spend time reffing games for anything such as tournaments, and also attend the occasional staff meetings. 
A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself: I've been known as Wolfi for mostly my whole Minecraft career, I am 14 years old and Canadian. I have many hobbies such as Hockey and very into Minecraft PvP. I've been playing Avicus for almost 3 years now, and loving the community more and more every day. I'm very hard working and like to get the job done as neat as possible. I have a passion for the things I do on a day to day basis. I'm a fast learner and very active on Minecraft, mostly the Avicus Network. 
Anything else?:  Thank you for taking the time and reading my application! Have a great day!
